how_to_create_vm_template: How to make a VM template?
create_vm_template_step_1: Open the details panel of the virtual machine.
create_vm_template_step_2: Confirm that the virtual machine is in the shutdown state.
create_vm_template_step_3: Click the "..." button in the toolbar and then select "Create VM Template".
create_vm_template_step_4: Select "Clone VM as VM Template" or "Convert VM into VM Template".
